Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Preventing/reversing health issues, Improve body composition and achieve sustainable weight loss.
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Early_Morning (optional): Option 3: Any 1 fruit (apple, orange, guava or papaya)
Meal_1: Option 2: Paneer cubes (100 g) + cucumber slices
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (small bowl ~150 g) + curd (small bowl)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + chicken curry (120 g) + vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + paneer curry (120 g) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + egg curry (2 eggs) + vegetable curry
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + fish curry (100–120 g) + vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + paneer cubes (80 g) + cucumber salad
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + egg omelette (2 eggs) + vegetable curry

Notes_and_Tips: Keep non-vegetarian meals to 3–4 times per week and use paneer or eggs on the remaining days.
Since you work indoors, include a 30-minute walk before work or after dinner whenever possible.
When attending social gatherings, eat a fruit or a small bowl of curd beforehand to help control portions.
Aim for 15–20 minutes of morning sunlight daily. Regular morning sunlight can help support your sleep cycle, energy levels and overall wellbeing.
Continue practicing yoga regularly and stay physically active throughout the day.
Drink at least 2.5–3 litres of water daily and maintain consistent meal timings.
